_about: Model family knowledge for arch_modelknow. One entry per family/line. Evidence tiers: [M] measured here (never stored in this file; comes from passports/results), [B] vendor card or published benchmark, [A] community report, [E] estimate. Entries are matched in order: specific lines (coder, hermes, distills) come before their base families. Priors are 0-1 starting points for ORDERING screens; measurement always decides. Research date 2026-11-05; sources listed per entry (model_landscape.md has the ones fetched today, the rest are vendor cards recalled, not re-fetched this session).

abliterated.effect: refusal direction removed from the weights. Typically costs a few benchmark points (mlabonne reports roughly 0-5 points, recovered partly by a DPO heal), can add looping and can disturb strict JSON / tool-call output; test tool calling after it.

uncensored.effect: fine-tuned or abliterated to drop refusals. Unless stated, the method is unknown: treat like abliteration (small quality cost, check structured output).

distill.effect: trained on a bigger model's answers. Gains are usually in reasoning style and length; claims are rarely benchmarked and long thinking costs time.

base.effect: a base (not instruction-tuned) model: it continues text, it does not follow chat instructions. Use only as a draft model or for FIM.

mtp.effect: carries multi-token-prediction heads: built-in speculative decoding (llama.cpp --spec-type draft-mtp) can give up to ~1.8x when the GGUF kept the MTP tensors.
